name: 308 GTB
description: The Ferrari 308 GTB (1975–1985) is Giugaro's masterpiece and the car that defined the mid-engine Ferrari formula for 50 years. Its 3.0-litre V8 producing 255 hp, combined with the first use of fibreglass body panels on a Ferrari GT, established the template that the 348, F355, 360, F430, 458, 488, F8, and 296 would follow.
